title: Existence of integral pullback tensor unit coherence
statement: The normalized integral pullback tensor comparison admits an isomorphism from the pullback of the source unit to the target unit satisfying both prescribed left and right unitor equations for every integral constructible input.

proof.text: Take the coherent unit isomorphism and both unit equations from pullbackTensorSystemComparison_unit. Compose its source and target with the fixed pullback-reduction and unit-reduction isomorphisms. Fully faithful coherent reduction lifts this composite to an integral unit isomorphism epsilon, whose mapped hom satisfies the prescribed conjugation identity.

For the left equation use reduced_square with source and target left unitors. The tensor-reduction characterization supplies the source square. Naturality of the target coherent left unitor and cancellation of the coherent unit isomorphism supply the target square. The private conjugate_tensor_comparison lemma proves the remaining comparison square from integralComparison_reduction, tensor-reduction naturality, and naturality of the coherent comparison. Faithfulness reflects the coherent unit equation to the required integral equation.

Repeat the same square with the right unitors and the unit in the second tensor input. The same lifted epsilon satisfies its conjugation identity, so the second coherent unit equation yields the right integral unit equation. Package these two equations for every integral constructible object.

lean.statement: theorem canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor_unit_exists {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] : ∃ ε : ((@constructibleIntegralPullback l _ E _ _ _ X Y f hX hY)).obj ((@pullbackTensorIntegralUnit l _ E _ _ _ Y hY)) ≅ (@pullbackTensorIntegralUnit l _ E _ _ _ X hX), ∀ M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y, (((@canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l _ E _ _ _ X Y f hX hY) ((@pullbackTensorIntegralUnit l _ E _ _ _ Y hY)) M).hom ≫ ((@constructibleIntegralTensor l _ E _ _ _ X hX)).map (Prod.mkHom ε.hom (𝟙 _)) ≫ ((@pullbackTensorIntegralLeftUnitor l _ E _ _ _ X hX) (((@constructibleIntegralPullback l _ E _ _ _ X Y f hX hY)).obj M)).hom = ((@constructibleIntegralPullback l _ E _ _ _ X Y f hX hY)).map ((@pullbackTensorIntegralLeftUnitor l _ E _ _ _ Y hY) M).hom) ∧ (((@canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l _ E _ _ _ X Y f hX hY) M ((@pullbackTensorIntegralUnit l _ E _ _ _ Y hY))).hom ≫ ((@constructibleIntegralTensor l _ E _ _ _ X hX)).map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) ε.hom) ≫ ((@pullbackTensorIntegralRightUnitor l _ E _ _ _ X hX) (((@constructibleIntegralPullback l _ E _ _ _ X Y f hX hY)).obj M)).hom = ((@constructibleIntegralPullback l _ E _ _ _ X Y f hX hY)).map ((@pullbackTensorIntegralRightUnitor l _ E _ _ _ Y hY) M).hom)
